message: When the lights go out, it can feel a bit unsettling, but I like to think of it as an opportunity for a cozy night in! I love gathering candles, blankets, and maybe even making some hot cocoa. It’s a chance to unplug and connect with family in a new way. If you're curious about how to prepare for power outages, I found a great resource that shares practical tips. What’s your favorite way to make a blackout feel like a cozy adventure? ☕️
